description:
Dockhand Mobile is a native iPhone and iPad client for managing your self-hosted Dockhand servers on the go.

Connect to one or more Dockhand instances, switch between environments from the main header and run the daily container operations you need without opening a laptop.

FEATURES
• Multiple servers, each isolated with its own URL, API token and selected environment
• Optional per-server custom HTTP headers for reverse proxies such as Cloudflare Access or Pangolin
• Environment dashboard: container health, CPU, memory, images, volumes, networks, stacks and events
• Containers: filter, sort, start, stop, restart, pause and unpause
• Logs, including live streaming when available
• Stacks: view related containers, edit compose and .env files with validation, redeploy with pull, build and force recreate options
• Images: inspect details, tags, labels and usage; pull, tag, delete and prune unused images
• Backups: run backups, review history and destinations
• Container update visibility

REQUIREMENTS
You need access to your own Dockhand server and an API token. The app does not include any server or hosting service.

Dockhand Mobile is an independent, open-source community client. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or maintained by the official Dockhand project. Docker is a trademark of Docker, Inc.
promotionalText: Manage containers, stacks, images and logs on your self-hosted Dockhand servers from your iPhone.
whatsNew:
Create and deploy Compose stacks directly from Dockhand Mobile.

- Create stacks with Compose YAML and an optional .env file. Save them for later or start them immediately.
- Follow stack deployments and container updates with live status and server output.
- Switch between servers and environments with lists that reload automatically and a stable server selector.
- See clearer update messages that distinguish recorded pending updates from a fresh image check.
- Retry a failed stack deployment without creating the stack again.
